title: Agentic Literature Extraction Augments Targeted Protein Degradation Databases
abstract: arXiv:2605.11221v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Predictive models in medicinal chemistry depend on structured assay data locked in primary publications. This bottleneck is acute in targeted protein degradation (TPD), where each assay record must combine compound identity, degradation target, recruiter, assay context, and endpoint values reported across sections, tables, and supplementary files. Existing TPD databases are manually curated and often lack assay context. We present an expert-in-the-loop large language model workflow in which a cross-validated prompt-refinement module adapts extraction instructions from scarce expert annotations. translated_title: 智能体文献抽取增强靶向蛋白降解数据库
translated_abstract: 药物化学中的预测模型依赖于锁定在原始出版物中的结构化实验数据。这一瓶颈在靶向蛋白降解（TPD）领域尤为突出，因为每条实验记录都需要整合化合物身份、降解靶点、招募者、实验背景以及分布在正文各章节、表格和补充文件中的终点数值。现有的TPD数据库均由人工整理，且往往缺乏实验背景信息。我们提出了一种专家在环的大型语言模型工作流程，其中交叉验证的提示词优化模块能够从稀缺的专家标注中自适应调整抽取指令。仅用七篇标注的分子胶文献，该工作流程就达到了记录级F1 = 0.98的抽取性能，并且仅通过术语替换就成功迁移到了蛋白水解靶向嵌合体（PROTACs）领域（F1 ≥ 0.93）。所构建的数据库AutoTPD比标准化参考数据库多包含81%和92%的分子胶和PROTAC记录。
tldr: 本研究提出专家在环的大语言模型工作流程，仅用七篇标注文献即实现高精度（F1=0.98）的靶向蛋白降解实验数据自动抽取，构建的AutoTPD数据库比现有参考数据库多出81%至92%的记录。
en_tdlr: An expert-in-the-loop LLM workflow achieves high-accuracy (F1=0.98) extraction of targeted protein degradation assay data from just seven annotated publications, building the AutoTPD database with 81-92% more records than existing reference databases.
